Name: Poke ball Collection
Author: Lucidvisionsinc
Description:
Grow Apricorns and Craft Poké Balls
Cultivate Apricorn trees and harvest their colorful fruits to use in specialized crafting machines.
The Apricorn Machine transforms colored Apricorns into their corresponding Apriballs, following the familiar color-based crafting system inspired by Pokémon. The Ancient Hisuian Apricorn Machine offers a different crafting method, using Brown Apricorns alongside additional materials such as Stone, Wood, Hardwood, and Coal to create Hisuian-style Poké Balls.
Not every Poké Ball is crafted the same way! Some can be purchased or obtained through in-game events, giving you different ways to expand your collection.
Two Items, Two Different Uses
Machine-crafted Apriballs and Hisuian-style Poké Balls have a special feature: each has a regular item version and a separate throwable weapon version.
Press the action button while holding a machine-crafted Poké Ball item to obtain its corresponding weapon version without losing the original.
[list]
[*]Regular item: Keep it for decoration, gifting, or collecting.[/*]
[*]Weapon version: Throw it at monsters as part of the mod’s Pokémon-inspired gameplay.[/*]
[/list]This lets you maintain your collection while also having throwable Poké Balls ready to use.
Pokémon-Inspired Gameplay
Take your Poké Balls beyond crafting and collecting! Throw them at monsters and hear Pokémon-inspired capture sound effects when using them.
Your Poké Ball Guidebook
The Parchment Poké Ball Guidebook provides information about the mod’s items and crafting recipes, helping you learn more about the available crafting options and resources.
Whether you’re a Pokémon fan, a collector, or a crafter, Poké Ball Collection offers new ways to bring a little Pokémon magic to your Stardew Valley adventure!
Installation Instructions
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] if you haven’t already.[/*]
[*]Install Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Install SpaceCore.[/*]
[*]Install Parchment.[/*]
[*]Download and extract Poké Ball Collection.[/*]
[*]Place the extracted mod folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Ensure all required dependencies are installed and up to date.[/*]
[/list]Main Features
[list]
[*]Grow Apricorn Trees: Cultivate colorful Apricorns for use in crafting their corresponding Apriballs.[/*]
[*]Apricorn Machine: Transform colored Apricorns into their matching Apriballs.[/*]
[*]Ancient Hisuian Apricorn Machine: Craft Hisuian-style Poké Balls using Brown Apricorns and additional materials, including Stone, Wood, Hardwood, and Coal.[/*]
[*]Dual-Item Functionality: Obtain a separate throwable weapon version of machine-crafted Apriballs and Hisuian-style Poké Balls while retaining the original item.[/*]
[*]Collect a Variety of Poké Balls: Obtain different Poké Balls through crafting, purchasing, and in-game events.[/*]
[*]Throwable Poké Balls: Use weapon versions of Poké Balls against monsters.[/*]
[*]Pokémon-Inspired Capture Sounds: Hear capture sound effects when throwing Poké Balls at monsters.[/*]
[*]Parchment Poké Ball Guidebook: Discover information about the mod’s items and crafting recipes through an in-game guidebook.[/*]
[/list]Requirements
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley — The base game.[/*]
[*]SMAPI — Required for loading mods.[/*]
[*]Content Patcher — Required dependency.[/*]
[*]SpaceCore — Required dependency.[/*]
[*]Parchment — Required dependency for the guidebook.[/*]
[/list]Please install all required dependencies before launching the game.
